title: Sarah Labahti, McCoy de Leon lead cast of Darryl Yap’s first horror film ‘VHS’

blocks.text: Sarah Lahbati and McCoy de Leon will lead the cast of Darryl Yap’s upcoming first horror movie, “VHS” (Viva Horror Stories). Viva Films unveiled the official poster for the film on Facebook on Saturday, Sept. 19, announcing Lahbati, de Leon, Ella Cruz, Kit Thompson, Sachzna Laparan, and Isay Alvarez as part of the cast. “You can’t spell TAkOt without TAO,” the production company said in its caption. “VHS” is being presented as the Halloween movie offering of Viva Films and Vincentiments as part of Viva Films’ 45th anniversary celebration.
